list.title: Understanding Authentication and Authorization: A Developer's Guide to Secure Web Applications
list.subheading: Explore the Foundations, Differences, and Implementation Strategies of Authentication and Authorization in Modern Web Development

list.title: Demystifying JWT: A Beginner's Guide to JSON Web Tokens
list.subheading: Understand the fundamentals of JWTs, their structure, use cases, and best practices for secure implementation in modern web applications.

list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Exploring Alternatives to JWT: Secure Token Strategies for Modern Web Applications

list.excerpt: Discover top alternatives to JWT for authentication, including opaque tokens, PASETO, and session-based auth. Learn their strengths, weaknesses, and implementation tips for secure apps.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Implementing JWT Authentication and Authorization in MERN Stack Applications

list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Securing Next.js Applications with JWT: A Comprehensive Guide to Authentication and Authorization

list.author: Paul Serban

list.author: Paul Serban
